name: Pale Sand, Dark Skies
source:
Waking up after a storm, you are excited to go to the nearby beach and see if anything interesting has washed up. Storms bring many strange things.

Pale Sand, Dark Skies is a short, chill mostly kinetic novel about a beachcomber coming across some ghost friends.

[Edited from [url=https://zeddybear.itch.io/pale-sand-dark-waves]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
暴风雨过后，你醒来，很高兴去附近的海滩看看是否有任何有趣的东西被冲上来。暴风雨带来许多奇怪的事情。

《苍白的沙子，黑暗的天空》是一部简短、冷酷、主要是动态的小说，讲述了一个海滩流浪者遇到了一些鬼魂朋友的故事。

[编辑自[url=https://zeddybear.itch.io/pale-sand-dark-waves]itch.io[/url]]
